sections.desc: The track opens with a shimmering, ethereal synth pad that gradually builds into a pulsating electronic beat. A smooth, melodic bassline enters, creating a groovy, danceable rhythm. Over this foundation, a male vocalist delivers lyrics with a cool, laid-back delivery, blending seamlessly with the atmospheric production. The overall mood is dreamy yet energetic, evoking late-night city vibes with a blend of nostalgia and forward momentum.
sections.lyrics:
Wake me up,
the world's on fire Dancing shadows under city lights,
Echoes of our laughter fill the air,
Electric pulses guide my every flight
